name: Folder Drive
summary: A folder under /tmp, browsed in a pane like a remote drive.
description: A sample location plugin. Each connection is a folder under /tmp that this plugin serves to Vektor over the plugin protocol: listing (paged), reading, writing, new folders, rename, move and permanent delete. It never touches a network. Use it to see how a location behaves in a pane, or copy it as the start of your own (WebDAV, a cloud drive).

fields.label: Folder
fields.help: A folder under /tmp. It must exist.

fields.label: Access code
fields.help: Needed only when the folder holds a file named .access-code. Kept in your keychain.
